info.name: Restaurant API - Assignment 2 Questions 4, 5 and 7
info.description: Q4 menu and Q5 authentication. Seed demo users, run Q5 customer/manager logins to capture tokens before Q4 mutations. Menu GET stays public; writes require a manager. Tokens are populated from actual login responses. Q7 adds server-priced orders, protected manager progression, table availability, customer bookings and conflict/status tests; run its folder sequentially after seed.

item.name: Question 7 Orders and Reservations
item.description: Run in order after seed. JWTs and document IDs captured at runtime. The chosen table slot must be free; use a different future date/time if occupied. Requests create demo documents; do not run against a production database.

exec: const items = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('q7MenuId', items.find(i => i.available)._id); pm.collectionVariables.set('q7UnavailableId', items.find(i => !i.available)._id);

const o=pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('q7OrderId', o._id); pm.test('Database price and total used', () => { pm.expect(o.total).to.equal(Math.round((o.subtotal+o.serviceCharge+o.salesTax-o.discount)*100)/100); pm.expect(o.status).to.equal('Pending'); });
